name: Data Analysis for Transportation Engineers
description: Introduction to common data types - pavement engineering, traffic engineering, and transportation planning data; national personal travel survey data-application of summary measures; probability distributions applicable to pavement condition rating, accident data, vehicle arrival, spot speed, trip length distribution, time allocation, mode choice, etc.; transportation problems involving single and multiple populations; simultaneous analysis multiple data types - time allocation, activity participation, and episode frequency data; inference testing –ratio and categorical data; experimental design for transportation planners; conditional distribution and regression - association among traffic speed, flow, and density; accident and safety data - data types and analysis approaches; need for multivariate analysis in transportation engineering; reliability in transport network analysis; bayesian approach for belief updating – application to advance traveler information system design; time series analysis and forecasting – applications to traffic forecasting.
